note.zh: 1605、1610、1611 之后，灭绝主义（is_homicidal）帝国进入 1616“够了”，只能拒绝；其他帝国进入 1615“外交机会”。
note.en: After 1605, 1610 or 1611, exterminator (is_homicidal) empires reach 1616 “Enough” and can only refuse; all others reach 1615 “Diplomatic Opportunity”.

note.zh: 与镜像帝国建立友好关系，此后可跨越裂隙贸易；获得 10 年“新友谊”与社会学研究（格式塔帝国另得“破碎大使”）。探索结束。
note.en: Friendly relations with the mirrored empire, with trade across the rift now possible; 10 years of New Friendship and society research (gestalt empires also gain Fractured Ambassadors). The exploration ends.

note.zh: 拒绝或无视对方的提议；获得凝聚力与星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Their offer is spurned or ignored; unity and astral threads; the exploration ends.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1；已存在镜像帝国或帝国为“裂隙世界”起源时为 0。开始探索时，隐藏事件 astral_rift.1699 复制探索帝国创建一个“镜像帝国”，把其主要（或狂热）思潮反转，并记下反转的是哪一种——各篇正文据此选择版本。
notes.en: Draw weight 1; 0 if a mirrored empire already exists or for the Riftworld origin. When exploration starts, hidden event astral_rift.1699 copies the explorer into a “mirrored empire” with one (fanatic) ethic inverted and records which — each chapter's text variant follows that record.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义、探索开始时创建镜像帝国的 1699（on_astral_rift_exploration_start）、1600–1625 全部事件、1620 调用的 astral_planes.1690 与探索结束时的清理 1698。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition, the mirrored-empire creation 1699 (on_astral_rift_exploration_start), every event 1600–1625, astral_planes.1690 called from 1620 and the cleanup 1698 at exploration end.

uncertain: The text variants depend on rift flags explorer_is_* written by 1699, which the V4 condition model shows as unresolved conditions.
